description: This file contains mock class definitions for web transport API interfaces used in testing, including mocks for StreamVisitor, Stream, SessionVisitor, and Session.

classes.name: MockStreamVisitor
classes.description: Mock implementation of StreamVisitor for testing.

classes.name: MockStream
classes.description: Mock implementation of Stream for testing.

classes.name: MockSessionVisitor
classes.description: Mock implementation of SessionVisitor for testing.

classes.name: MockSession
classes.description: Mock implementation of Session for testing.
